utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and send you the repair drive details as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. Once you have them, send the details my way and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll check around and pass along the repair drive details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd is the quickest stop for tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — 9 to 11 on Saturday still sounds best for the repair drive, and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — that time works for me too. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — the Saturday 9 to 11 window still looks best, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive details while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday 9 to 11 at the community center, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the time and place exactly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s right — Saturday 9 to 11 at the community center. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — Saturday morning still works for me, and I can help let the school parents know. What else should I coordinate for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — if you can spread the word to the school parents, that helps a lot. I’ll keep sorting the tools and I may ask for a few more supplies if we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll spread the word to the school parents and let you know if I hear of any extra supplies. Just send me the list if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the repair list, extra screws, and a few hand tools, and I can help sort and hand things out too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, then I can pass the repair list along cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — once you have the time and place, send me the repair list and I’ll bring what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’m a bit forgetful, but I’ll head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd and check what I can find for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let the neighbors know, and once you’ve checked the hardware tent, send me what you find so I can line up help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll check the tent and send you a list of what I find.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll keep it quiet and come by after dusk. Just point me to the biggest gap, and I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — just tell me the exact spot after dusk, and I’ll point out the biggest gap one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll look for the biggest gap after dusk and bring what I can quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend you a hammer and screwdriver set for the repair drive. Let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep an eye out for the confirmed details and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — just let me know if you need the tools, and I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — could you send the repair drive details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’m still sorting through everything, but I’ll send the repair drive details over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still tracking tape, screws, and a few spare lightbulbs. If you can bring any of those, I’ll note what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can do that — I’ll check what I’ve got and bring any tape, screws, or spare lightbulbs I can find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a huge help — I’ll keep the list updated as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll help with tape and screws, and I can look for spare lightbulbs too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd for the repair drive, since that’s the closest stop with tools. If you find another stop, send it my way and I’ll point you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll check the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd first, and if I spot another stop, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After dusk still works for me — I can show you the back fence by the alley then. Let’s keep it quiet and start there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — after dusk works, and we’ll start quietly by the back fence by the alley. I’m still locking in the last details for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the full update soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Send me the full update when it’s ready, and I’ll be there after dusk by the back fence.
